note: Style A: bright, minimal, clean. Realistic but styled, like a top specialty cafe's own Instagram.
still: Vertical photo by a professional cafe content creator, shot on a full-frame mirrorless camera with a 35mm lens at f/2.8. A beautiful, spotless specialty coffee bar in soft morning daylight from a large window. A matte white espresso machine with wooden handles on a pale oak counter, portafilter locked in, a handmade off-white ceramic cup centred on the drip tray under the spouts. The counter is clean and deliberately styled: one small vase with a single dried branch, a neat stack of two ceramic cups, nothing else. Pale plaster wall behind, gentle natural shadows. Real textures and true-to-life colours, soft natural contrast, calm and airy, tidy and premium. Authentic photograph, not a 3D render, not over-sharpened, no artificial glow, no bokeh light orbs. No people, no hands, no text, no logos, no brand names, no lettering anywhere on the machine.
motion: A slow, graceful push-in toward the ceramic cup. Espresso begins to flow from the spouts in two fine, steady streams and fills the cup with a smooth hazelnut-coloured crema. A faint wisp of steam rises in the daylight. Shot on a mirrorless camera with a stabilised gimbal: steady, confident movement with natural micro-motion, not robotic. Real-time speed, true-to-life liquid, natural colours. No people, no hands, no text.
